interpretation.label: directional_head_did_not_change_zworld_at_this_operating_point
interpretation.combination_rule: PASS iff C_on_clears_floor (load-bearing) AND C_off_subfloor_replication. C_decode_lift is REPORTED, not gating: it attributes a lift rather than producing one, and a lift with a flat decode is a real and interesting result (it would mean the auxiliary loss helped by some route other than exposing the gradient) that must not be suppressed into a FAIL.

preconditions.name: field_loss_off::zworld_encoder_trained_in_p0
preconditions.description: The P0a SD-070 recipe must actually move split_encoder.world_encoder. Both arms run the same recipe, so this speaks for both.
preconditions.control: latent_stack weight delta over the warmup, vs the family's guard floor

preconditions.name: field_loss_off::zworld_not_collapsed
preconditions.description: z_world must retain more than one effective dimension. The amend's own ML note names 25-dim-target-dominates-P0 collapse as its hazard, and the substrate has measured PR 9.21 -> 1.06 under a related recipe. A collapsed arm is an operating- point failure, NOT evidence the directional head does not help.
preconditions.control: participation ratio of frozen z_world over the decode-probe samples

preconditions.name: field_loss_off::d3_local_view_greedy_clears_floor
preconditions.description: The env must be floor-achievable FROM THE SAME 5x5 resource field the amend supervises -- closes the V3-EXQ-732a privileged-oracle confound, so an arm that fails is genuinely under-powered rather than obs-starved.
preconditions.control: local_view_greedy worst-seed mean resources/ep vs the 1.0 competence floor

criteria.name: C_on_clears_floor
criteria.description: field_head_on clears the 1.0 competence floor on a strict majority of seeds, reading z_world alone

criteria.name: C_off_subfloor_replication
criteria.description: field_head_off does NOT clear the floor -- replicates the 948/813 latent anchor. If this fails the contrast is uninterpretable, which is why it is a criterion and not an assumption

criteria.name: C_decode_lift
criteria.description: held-out linear decode of resource_field_view from frozen z_world lifts by >= 0.05 r2 on the ON arm AND clears r2 > 0 absolutely -- the mechanism check that makes a competence lift attributable to directional content. The absolute floor is load-bearing: a margin between two sub-mean decodes is a lift of nothing (red-team F4)

null_reading.directional_content_present_but_does_not: decode lifted, competence did not -- displaces the observation-interface leg toward the CONSUMER side; shape (b) is the next build
null_reading.directional_head_did_not_change_zworld_a: neither lifted -- a statement about the P0a recipe at resource_field_weight=0.50, NOT about the hypothesis. Re-run at another weight before concluding
